desc: Orlivane reflective dog vest combines fluorescent color with gray reflective trim, a reflective band and paw print details on both sides to help your dog be seen during early and late walks. The cape lies over the back and fastens with straps under the neck and chest. Choose Fluorescent Yellow or Fluorescent Orange in S, M, L, XL or 2XL for walks, trails and hunting season outings. Measure your dog's back length, chest and neck before ordering and compare all three measurements with the size chart. Manual measurement, allow slight deviation.
b: BE SEEN ON WALKS — Fluorescent color and reflective details help make your dog easier to see on early morning, evening and nighttime walks.
REFLECTIVE DETAILS — Gray reflective trim follows the edges, with a reflective band across the vest and a gray reflective paw print on each side.
CAPE DESIGN — Lay the vest over your dog's back, then fasten the straps under the neck and chest before heading out.
TWO BRIGHT COLORS — Choose Fluorescent Yellow or Fluorescent Orange for daily walks, woodland trails and hunting season outings.
FIVE SIZES — Available in S, M, L, XL and 2XL. Measure your dog's back, chest and neck and check the size chart before ordering. Manual measurement, allow slight deviation.
